$comment: Do not hand-edit: retune the brand and re-run, or the two will disagree.
`tokens` is the brand's motion system as-is. `presets` is the prose that
reaches Claude in the Recast prompt, built from those tokens so it cannot
ask for a timing the brand does not define.

brand.label: Brand — the house motion
brand.hint: The brand's own scale and curves. Restrained, and allowed one overshoot where it is earned.
direction: Motion answers to four words: purpose, precision, restraint, intent. Every choice below should be defensible against them.
Durations come from the brand's scale and nothing between: 100ms (instant), 200ms (fast), 400ms (base), 600ms (slow), 900ms (deliberate).
Easing is by role, not by taste. Arriving: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Leaving: cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45). Already on screen and changing place or size: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1).
Most things enter at 400ms on the enter curve, travelling 24px. A nudge travels 8px; a large surface crossing real distance travels 56px.
Something popping in scales from 0.96, not from zero.
Reveal a group as a group: 70ms between siblings.
cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) is the ONLY curve allowed to overshoot, and only for a deliberate look-at-me. Do not reach for it because a moment feels flat.
Once a slide has arrived it holds still. No looping, drifting or pulsing under narration.

minimal.label: Minimal — cuts and fades
minimal.hint: Nothing travels. For dense content or fast narration.
direction: Motion answers to four words: purpose, precision, restraint, intent. Every choice below should be defensible against them.
Durations come from the brand's scale and nothing between: 100ms (instant), 200ms (fast), 400ms (base), 600ms (slow), 900ms (deliberate).
Easing is by role, not by taste. Arriving: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Leaving: cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45). Already on screen and changing place or size: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1).
Cross-fades only, at 200ms on the enter curve. Nothing translates, scales, rotates or staggers.
Slides cut between each other on the beat of the narration.

energetic.label: Energetic — quicker, more travel
energetic.hint: The same curves, shorter and larger. For promos rather than walkthroughs.
direction: Motion answers to four words: purpose, precision, restraint, intent. Every choice below should be defensible against them.
Durations come from the brand's scale and nothing between: 100ms (instant), 200ms (fast), 400ms (base), 600ms (slow), 900ms (deliberate).
Easing is by role, not by taste. Arriving: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Leaving: cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45). Already on screen and changing place or size: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1).
Enters run at 200ms and may travel 56px. Exits stay on the exit curve — nobody needs to watch something leave.
Stagger tightens to about half the brand's 70ms.
cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) is still the only overshoot, and still only where it is earned.
Movement stops once a slide is in place. The energy is in the arrival, not in ambient drift.
